ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 94% of the visible surface area, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters and linear features providing high contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation occupies the central and medial regions of both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white geometric clusters are located at the extreme distal tips. Sparse high-intensity pixel points and lines are distributed across the medial and lateral surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate angular measurement of 50 degrees; depth is approximately 12% of the total visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous superior boundary characterized by irregular sawtooth serrations with vertical pixel-amplitudes varying between 4 and 18 pixels; frequency of peaks increases towards the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves originating from the central notch and sweeping upward and outward to the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular and semi-circular high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the distal 5% of both the left and right lobe edges. Individual circular high-intensity spots are visible on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); prominent parallel diagonal lines on the left lobe and scattered individual horizontal/diagonal lines across the central and right medial regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast encrustation at both distal tips; multiple sets of linear rake marks (scars) across the ventral surface pigment.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized concentration of dense, textured high-intensity material (barnacle clusters) limited almost exclusively to the terminal edges of the fluke lobes.
